clips.why: Short comic anecdote. Hook: 'I remember playing Final Fantasy 16 on my Deck streamed from my desktop' (dropping the leading 'But'); good for 30 seconds, 'oh wow, it looks good', then latency, lag, input delay, 'na na na'. Payoff: 'even the tiniest fraction of input delay, your boy can notice it, and it's game breaking.' The 'might not be game breaking for everybody' after is a hedge.

Hot take: the two things that break a game for him are input delay and stuttering; even a micro stutter every minute or two is infuriating, and 'I would rather a game run at 30 FPS than play at 60 FPS that stutters.' Opens on 'to me, the two biggest things that are game breaking' (dropping 'But'); starting at 'It's ridiculous how many games stutter' (305.1) also works. Lands on the 30-vs-60 line / 'I think that stuff is game breaking'.

Personal take: 'Remote play experiences for me have always been garbage', game streaming in general garbage, 'your boy ain't gonna pay a premium' for fast internet, OnLive a decade ago, then Steam Deck in the same room as his PC still lagging. Lands on 'man, this isn't how I want to play games, it's not my cup of tea' (252.9); ending on the same-room latency line (242.1) also works. The FF16 anecdote that follows is its own clip.

also_ok.why: Opinion: Big Picture's aesthetic is one of the best dashboards in gaming; ranks PS5 first, Big Picture second, Xbox third, Switch clean too. Short (17s) unless opened on 'Big Art mode, I think, is pretty cool' (411.9), which adds the Valve-bridging-PC-and-console context. Mild, so not insisted on.

negatives.why: Reading Valve's PyroWave post off the screen: bandwidth, latency, YUV 4:4:4, HDR, bitrate slider. Numbers and specs, no point of his own.
'Here's something I personally am really excited for' then the Steam beta patch notes read aloud (Big Art mode, screensavers, bug fixes).
Recap of both updates, restating 'remote play never has been worthwhile for me' without the story.
Intro and agenda for the video.
Post-roll call to hit the bell notification.
